versions.changelog:
book-report 1.0.0 — Initial release focused on structured book reports for popular Chinese literature.

- Input a book name to get two outputs: an HTML self-study report and a conversational “弹药库”.
- Covers high-profile Chinese books well (e.g., major award-winners); warns users for less-supported genres.
- Collects data primarily from Baidu Baike, Chinese Wikipedia, and Zhihu; avoids sources like Douban and web novel sites.
- Extracts 9 key fields (summary, themes, characters, awards, etc.) per book; “弹药库” includes opening lines, stories, talking points, and closers.
- Built-in data quality safeguards: unverifiable details are omitted or marked, and results are withheld if sources are missing.
- Notifies user of exact report file paths after generation.
